name: Simple Battery Charge Protection
author: etidona
description: One-click battery charge protection: ON stops charging at 80%, OFF charges to 100%. No TLP and no setup: it finds your battery by itself, asks for your password only once and keeps your choice after a reboot. If the battery also has a start threshold, ON lowers it to 75% and OFF restores the original value. On first use it installs a udev rule in /etc/udev/rules.d (via pkexec) that gives your user write access to the battery charge threshold. The rule stays after uninstalling; the README explains how to remove it.
